questions.stem: A 12-year-old boy presents with a first unprovoked generalized tonic-clonic seizure. His physical exam and blood work are normal. MRI shows a focal cortical dysplasia. EEG shows epileptiform discharges over the left temporal region. Which of the following is the strongest predictor of seizure recurrence in this patient?
questions.stemHtml: A 12-year-old boy presents with a first unprovoked generalized tonic-clonic seizure. His physical exam and blood work are normal. MRI shows a focal cortical dysplasia. EEG shows epileptiform discharges over the left temporal region. Which of the following is the strongest predictor of seizure recurrence in this patient?

options.label: D
options.text: Absence of family history of epilepsy
